title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: assign Anthropic model access to specific users and groups
summary: Hold: the environment-group guidance omits Microsoft's requirement that the environments be Managed Environments. The main access paths, regional defaults, retention periods and December option changes are supported; the claim about what tenants first assessed is not documented.

claims.claim: The roadmap introduces admin controls for Anthropic as a model provider for specific users and groups.
claims.quote: This feature introduces admin controls for managing Anthropic as a model provider for specific users and groups in the tenant.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Scope; controls[1].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Claude models are on by default for most commercial customers outside EU/EFTA and UK.
claims.quote: Microsoft enables Claude models on by default for most customers in commercial cloud (excluding EU/EFTA and UK).

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Claude models in Microsoft offerings are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary.
claims.quote: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot, Researcher, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary

claims.claim: The general Claude availability default in EU/EFTA and UK is disabled.
claims.quote: For these regions, the AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors setting for Claude models appears but the default is set to No users. These regions include the European Union (EU), the European Free Trade Association (EFTA), and the United Kingdom (UK).

claims.claim: The apps-only setting is enabled by default for EU/EFTA/UK tenants created after March 25, 2026.
claims.quote: This setting is enabled by default for tenants in the EU, EFTA, and UK that were created after March 25, 2026.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: After rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: For EU/EFTA/UK tenants, All users for Microsoft 365 apps only is removed starting December 9, 2026.
claims.quote: Starting on December 9, 2026, the following setting changes are taking effect: ... The All users for Microsoft 365 apps only option will no longer be available.

claims.claim: An existing All users for Microsoft 365 apps only selection changes to All users on December 9, 2026.
claims.quote: If the All users for Microsoft 365 apps only option is currently selected, the selection will change to the All users option.

claims.claim: If no previous option was selected, the selection changes to All users on December 9, 2026.
claims.quote: If you haven't previously made any selection, your selection will change to All users.

claims.claim: Other selections, including No users, do not change.
claims.quote: If you've selected any other option, including No users, your selection won't change.

claims.claim: Microsoft Product Terms and DPA apply where Anthropic is a Microsoft subprocessor, except for models labelled with Data Retention.
claims.quote: Unless models are labeled "Anthropic models with Data Retention," the Microsoft Product Terms and Microsoft Data Protection Addendum (DPA) apply

claims.claim: Anthropic models with Data Retention operate under Anthropic's own terms as an independent processor.
claims.quote: Anthropic acts as an independent processor and use of Anthropic models with Data Retention is subject to acceptance of Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service and Anthropic's Data Protection Addendum.

claims.claim: For Data Retention models, Anthropic stores most inputs and outputs for up to 30 days.
claims.quote: This means that Anthropic (not Microsoft) stores most inputs and outputs for up to 30 days before deleting them.

claims.claim: Content identified by Anthropic's classifiers as potentially violating its Usage Policy may be retained for up to two years.
claims.quote: If Anthropic's trust and safety classifiers identify potential violations of Anthropic's Usage Policy, Anthropic may retain content (inputs and outputs) for up to two years

claims.claim: Trust and safety classification scores for those potential violations may be retained for up to seven years.
claims.quote: Anthropic may retain content (inputs and outputs) for up to two years and trust and safety classification scores for up to seven years.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Anthropic models with Data Retention are off for all scenarios until a tenant administrator explicitly opts in.
claims.quote: No users will have access to these models until the tenant admin explicitly opts in to enable use of Anthropic models with Data Retention.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The tenant admin separately chooses all or specific users or groups for Data Retention models in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Anthropic models with Data Retention ... have additional controls in the Microsoft 365 admin center ... The tenant admin must also choose which users (all or specific users or groups) can access and use these models.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Learn says Claude models are coming into the EU Data Boundary starting in December 2026.
claims.quote: Claude models from Anthropic are coming into the EU Data Boundary starting in December 2026.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The two named Anthropic implementation pages publish no separate Claude licence, price or meter at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot Claude Anthropic models license price meter separate licensing. Opened connect-to-ai-subprocessor and copilot-ai-provider-user-sec-group-access in full: neither names a separate licence, price or meter. General model billing is documented elsewhere.

claims.claim: The user and group assignment option is inside the already licensed Microsoft Copilot product, so its licensing model is included.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot | Users need a Microsoft Copilot license and a qualifying prerequisite license.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft does not separately state the default enforcement state of the new assignment control, as distinct from regional provider availability.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot Anthropic specific users groups assignment default enforcement all users No users. Read assignment, subprocessor and apps-only pages: regional availability defaults are explicit; no separate default enforcement state for the new assignment control is stated.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The first control's Microsoft 365 admin center path reaches Anthropic user and group assignment.
claims.quote: Copilot > Settings > View all ... AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors ... Available subprocessors for your organization ... Anthropic ... Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Open questions: automation
claims.claim: No Microsoft Graph or PowerShell operation for assigning Anthropic provider access is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Anthropic AI provider user group access assignment Microsoft Graph beta admin settings PowerShell; Microsoft Graph copilot admin Anthropic subprocessor settings update access users groups API PowerShell reference. Read copilotAdminSetting: no properties; only limitedMode relationship.

claims.claim: The second control's Microsoft 365 admin center path reaches Disable Anthropic as a Microsoft subprocessor.
claims.quote: Copilot > Settings ... User access ... AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors ... Available subprocessors for your organization ... Disable Anthropic as a Microsoft subprocessor

claims.claim: No automation operation for disabling Anthropic as a Microsoft subprocessor is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Anthropic AI provider Microsoft Graph beta admin settings PowerShell enable disable subprocessor; Microsoft Graph copilot admin Anthropic subprocessor settings update access users groups API PowerShell reference. Read subprocessor page and copilotAdminSetting: no matching operation.

claims.claim: Disabling Anthropic as an AI subprocessor removes the option for users to use Claude models.
claims.quote: Once you disable Anthropic as an AI subprocessor, users won't have the option to use Claude models.

claims.claim: Claude models can be enabled again later after disabling them.
claims.quote: You can choose to enable Claude models at a later date if desired.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; controls[1].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Enabling a provider in Microsoft 365 does not automatically make its models available in Power Platform; a second environment or group action is required.
claims.quote: External models require two separate admin actions. ... Enabling a provider in Microsoft 365 doesn't automatically make its models available in Power Platform.

claims.where: Governance controls: Power Platform second layer
claims.claim: A Power Platform system admin allows the provider's models in an environment or environment group.
claims.quote: Then, a Power Platform system admin allows the provider's models in an environment or environment group.

claims.where: Governance controls: Power Platform environment path
claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features reaches applicable provider On or Off settings.
claims.quote: select Manage ... select Environments, and then select the environment ... select Settings ... select Product > Features ... turn each applicable model provider setting On or Off.

claims.where: Governance controls: Power Platform environment group rules
claims.claim: The alternative environment-group rule route is presented without its Managed Environments prerequisite.
claims.quote: If an environment is part of an environment group, use environment group rules to manage external models across the group. ... Environments in an environment group must be managed environments.
claims.fix: Add immediately after the sentence offering environment group rules: 'For the environment-group route, environments in the group must be Managed Environments.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/allow-llm-generative-responses.

claims.claim: The known-issues page documents an Agent Blocked error for ungranted users of third-party-model Copilot Studio agents added to Microsoft 365 Copilot or Teams.
claims.quote: The following known issues apply to agents built with Copilot Studio and added to Microsoft 365 Copilot or Microsoft Teams. ... Users who aren't granted access to the model receive the "Agent Blocked" error.

claims.claim: Many tenants first assessed OpenAI models before Claude.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot OpenAI models Anthropic different processor initial models tenants assessed. Read application-card and model-availability excerpts, plus the cited Anthropic implementation page: none states which models tenants first assessed.
claims.fix: Remove 'many tenants first assessed' from the opening sentence of Why it matters.

claims.claim: Claude's Anthropic processor is different from OpenAI.
claims.quote: Claude Opus and Claude Sonnet models provided by Anthropic ... GPT models provided by OpenAI
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/microsoft-365-copilot-application-card for the comparison of model providers in Why it matters.
